title: Standard iGEM Cell Measurement Protocol
author: Traci Haddock-Angelli
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5nxg5fn
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Transform E. coli DH5α
steps.instruction: Transform Escherichia coli DH5α with the specified plasmids (all in pSB1C3) following the iGEM protocol for competent cell creation, competency measurement, and DNA resuspension.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Cultures
steps.instruction: Pick 2 colonies from each transformation plate and inoculate them in 5-10 mL LB medium supplemented with Chloramphenicol (25 mg/ml in EtOH).

substeps.instruction: Grow cells overnight (16-18 hours) at 37 °C and 220 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare 1:10 Dilutions
steps.instruction: Make a 1:10 dilution of each overnight culture in LB with Chloramphenicol by adding 0.5 mL of culture into 4.5 mL of LB with Chloramphenicol.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the Abs 600 of the 1:10 diluted cultures and record the data in your notebook.

steps.title: Standardize Culture Density
steps.instruction: Dilute the cultures further to a target Abs 600 of 0.02 in a final volume of 12 mL LB medium with Chloramphenicol in a 50 mL falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Use an amber falcon tube or cover the tube with foil to block light.

steps.title: Collect Baseline Samples
steps.instruction: Prior to incubation (0 hours), take 500 μL samples of the diluted cultures into 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Collect samples for 8 devices, two colonies per device (16 tubes total).

steps.title: Incubate Cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate the remaining cultures at 37 °C and 220 rpm for 6 hours.

steps.title: Collect Final Samples
steps.instruction: At 6 hours of incubation, take 500 μL samples of the cultures into 1.5 mL eppendorf tubes and place them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Measurement Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare two plates (one for 0 hours, one for 6 hours) to read fluorescence and absorbance.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 μL of each sample into wells: 4 replicates of colony #1 in rows A, B, C, and D; 4 replicates of colony #2 in rows E, F, G, and H.
Include 8 control wells in column 9 containing 100 μL of LB with Chloramphenicol only.

steps.title: Configure Instrument and Read Plates
steps.instruction: Set the instrument to the settings that provided the best results in calibration curves to ensure no measurements are off scale.

substeps.instruction: Set instrument temperature to room temperature (approximately 20-25 °C) if variable settings are available.
